questions.question: Why should you run and synchronize at least one warmup step before entering `with jax.profiler.trace(trace_dir):` on a TPU VM?
options: Because `jax.profiler.trace` deletes all model weights if warmup is skipped
So the captured `*.xplane.pb` trace measures steady-state TPU execution and collective communication rather than one-time Python tracing and XLA HLO compilation
Because `bfloat16` only works inside a profiler context
questions.explanation: Separating warmup from the traced steps ensures the XProf timeline reflects actual steady-state device execution, host input dispatch, and ICI collectives.
